articles.title: Pink Soup Fever: How a Cold Beet Dish Drew 100,000 People to Vilnius
articles.summary: Vilnius turned into a pink playground for the annual Pink Soup Fest, celebrating Lithuania's iconic cold beet soup, šaltibarščiai. Over 100,000 attendees, including a UK tourist in homemade pink knight armor, joined synchronized lunches and parades. The festival is a tourism magnet blending food and spectacle.

articles.title: At Key Asia Summit, Hegseth Pushes Allies to Counter China—but Stays Silent on Taiwan
articles.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth urged Asian allies to boost military spending against China's 'historic buildup' at the Shangri-La Dialogue, but notably omitted Taiwan from his speech. Experts called the address 'light on substance,' as regional nations feel caught between U.S.-China competition. China sent a lower-level delegation.

articles.title: As Corporate Sponsorships Fade, Pride Celebrations Face an Uncertain Future
articles.summary: Pride festivals nationwide are grappling with a sharp drop in corporate sponsorships, which organizers link to political pressure against DEI initiatives. Pittsburgh Pride is racing to fill a funding gap, while Tampa Pride canceled its event. Experts say corporate allyship is now seen as a risk.
